literature.literature_legacy_aliases: CHIBIN; Pero; Peritrophin-A-like; chitin-binding domain protein
literature.literature_knockdown_summary: Approximately 90-99% target knockdown reported; CHIBIN single-target knockdown was among the strongest.
literature.literature_phenotype_summary: CHIBIN knockdown was associated with approximately 40-50% decrease in mite survival.
literature.literature_replication_note: Target re-used as Pero in Muita et al. 2026 with advanced dsRNA designs.
literature.reference_title: The salivary gland transcriptome of Varroa destructor reveals suitable targets for RNAi-based mite control

literature.literature_delivery_route: advanced loop-ended/asymmetric dsRNA; immersion and indirect feeding
literature.literature_knockdown_summary: Advanced designs produced design-dependent target silencing within the study's ~36-86% range.
literature.literature_phenotype_summary: Advanced dsRNA designs produced design-dependent enhanced mortality compared with conventional dsRNA; study reports ~32-56% mortality increases across tested conditions/designs.
literature.literature_replication_note: Independent design/formulation follow-up to Becchimanzi et al. CHIBIN work.
literature.reference_title: Novel dsRNA designs increase the stability and bioefficacy of RNAi-based pesticides for Varroa destructor
